Enabled.Name: Use Portrait Picker on my sheets
Enabled.Hint: When on, clicking an actor's portrait opens the Portrait Picker. Shift+click always opens Foundry's standard file picker.

PortraitScale.Name: Portrait mode image scale
PortraitScale.Hint: How many times larger a token's image is drawn in Portrait mode. The token still takes up its normal grid space.

Debug.Name: Debug logging
Debug.Hint: Print extra 'portrait_picker |' messages to the browser console (F12) to help with troubleshooting.

Mode.Label: Tokens on this scene
Mode.NoTokens: (No linked token on this scene; only the portrait and prototype token will change.)

Errors.OpenFailed: Portrait Picker could not open. Press F12 and check the Console for details.
Errors.NoFolder: Portrait Picker: couldn't open any image folder, not even "assets". Check that Data/assets exists on the server.
Errors.ActorUpdateFailed: Portrait Picker: couldn't save the new image for "{name}". Press F12 and check the Console for details.

Warnings.FolderMissing: Portrait Picker: couldn't open the folder "{missing}", so it's showing "{shown}" instead. Check the folder exists and its name matches exactly (including capital letters).
Warnings.FolderUnreadable: Portrait Picker: couldn't open the folder "{folder}". It may have been moved or deleted.
Warnings.NoBrowsePermission: Portrait Picker: you don't have the "Use File Browser" permission. Ask your GM to enable it.
Warnings.NoActorPermission: Portrait Picker: you don't have permission to change "{name}".
Warnings.NoTokenPermission: Portrait Picker: you don't have permission to change the token "{name}" on this scene, so it was skipped.
Warnings.TokenUpdateFailed: Portrait Picker: couldn't update the token "{name}" on this scene. Press F12 and check the Console for details.
